sentences.text: He further submits that all material witnesses have been recorded even the prosecutrix has also been recorded.

He further submits that as per the statements of prosecutrix, the present applicant was not directly involved in the crime, he met with the prosecutrix only in Ahemdabad and prosecutrix has claimed that she was major and as such present applicant and prosecutrix both has entered into the marriage and was living like a husband and wife.
After recovery of proesecutrix she was brought to her parents who stated that the prosecutrix was again got married.
At present, she is residing with her husband.

He further submits that under such circumstance though the age of prosecutrix was shown at the time of incident was about 14 years but the parents were also not sure as to on what basis they got the age of prosecutrix recorded but in examination they have said they did not know about the date of birth of the prosecutrix.
On the other hand, counsel for State has opposed the bail and submitted that looking into the overall circumstances and the age of prosecutrix, bail application of the applicant deserves to be dismissed.

Considering the arguments advanced by counsel for the parties, perusal of case diary, the fact that the material witnesses have been recorded and also the fact that the present applicant has not done any forceful act with the prosecutrix who has entered into the marriage with some other boy, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.
